context_requirements: Expression of the relevant interleukin receptor
No strong dominant transcriptional program from the cell line that would mask a weak response
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent change in any landmark gene at 6 h or 24 h that is shared across multiple cell lines and not explained by vehicle or general stress
Consistent induction of canonical interleukin/STAT/NF-kB target genes in the landmark set
